title: Design: no amber note for a customer on the same tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open work order 1's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Change Customer.
  4. Pick customer B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Change Customer.

Step 3:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 4:

  • Update Customer turns blue.
  • No amber box appears under the pickers.
  • The dialog matches picture 14.6.
